description: Quantitative comparison table of 17 proof-producing compilation and certificate-checking architectures with primary-source citations.

systems.name: Proof-Carrying Code (Touchstone / Special J) & Oracle-Based PCC
sources: Colby, Lee, Necula et al. (PLDI 2000, doi:10.1145/349299.349315)
Necula & Rahul (POPL 2001, Oracle-Based Checking of Untrusted Software)
systems.certificate_format: LF deductive representations (Explicit LF -> Implicit LF_i -> Binary bit-stream Oracle strings driving a nondeterministic Prolog/Horn logic interpreter over VCGen obligations)
systems.size_vs_code: Explicit LF: 1.5x-4.0x machine code; Implicit LF_i: ~0.30x-0.90x; Oracle bit-stream: 0.10x-0.19x of native x86/DEC Alpha machine code (12%-20% overhead on Special J Java benchmarks)
systems.generation_time: 1.2x-2.0x of base compilation time (Touchstone / Special J)
systems.checking_time: 1.3 ms-45 ms per kernel filter / Java class file (linear in proof size for LF_i; linear in VC search trace for Oracle PCC)
systems.tcb: 23,000 LoC C (VCGen + LF type checker) in Touchstone; reduced to ~2,400 LoC C for Oracle PCC checker + ~1,500 LoC LF rules (unverified VCGen remains in TCB)
systems.completeness: Complete for type/memory safety invariants propagated by the certifying compiler's loop-invariant annotations; not functional equivalence
systems.optimizations_covered: Register allocation, instruction scheduling, loop invariant code motion, array bounds-check elimination, null-check elimination
systems.acceptance_rate: 100% on Touchstone / Special J safe subsets (safety only)

systems.name: Typed Assembly Language (TALx86) & Foundational PCC (FPCC)
systems.certificate_format: Basic-block register-file and stack-frame type annotations (.tal / binary TAL types); FPCC: foundational Coq/Twelf semantic type-safety derivations down to machine ISA decoding
systems.size_vs_code: TALx86 uncompressed: ~1.0x-2.0x object code; compressed binary TAL: 0.25x-0.45x of x86 object code
systems.generation_time: Type-directed Popcorn -> TALx86 compilation: ~1.3x base compile time
systems.checking_time: Syntactic TALx86 linear scan: <50 ms per module; FPCC foundational Twelf/Coq kernel checking: seconds per module
systems.tcb: TALx86: ~8,000 LoC OCaml type checker + assembler; FPCC: ~2,700 LoC LF/Coq ISA semantics + kernel
systems.completeness: Complete for System F / Popcorn type-preserving compilation; does not prove input-output functional equivalence
systems.optimizations_covered: Closure conversion, CPS/SSA lowering, register allocation, stack frame layout, simple dead-code elimination
systems.acceptance_rate: 100% for programs compiled by the type-preserving Popcorn compiler

systems.name: Pnueli, Siegel, and Singerman Translation Validation
systems.certificate_format: Cut-point mapping, control-abstraction mapping, data-abstraction mapping, and per-cut-point invariants forming a Proof Script discharged by TLV/CVC
systems.size_vs_code: ~0.5x-2.0x of source/target IR text (cut-point variable mappings + invariant formulas)
systems.generation_time: 10 ms-500 ms per routine on SIGNAL-to-C synchronous reactive code
systems.checking_time: 100 ms-several seconds per routine via BDD/SMT verification condition checking
systems.tcb: Unverified C verification-condition generator + BDD/SMT solver
systems.completeness: Sound for refinement of synchronous single-loop reactive programs; incomplete when loop structure changes non-structurally
systems.optimizations_covered: Synchronous clock-calculus scheduling, scalarization, dead-code elimination in SIGNAL->C
systems.acceptance_rate: High on single-loop synchronous SIGNAL programs; inapplicable to general control-flow restructuring

systems.name: Necula Translation Validation for an Optimizing Compiler (GCC 2.91)
systems.certificate_format: Inferred simulation relation (control-flow cut-point correspondence + conjunction of linear/Herbrand equalities between source and target RTL variables) checked by symbolic execution + Nelson-Oppen congruence/linear solver
systems.size_vs_code: No external certificate persisted by default; internal simulation relation has O(|V_src| + |V_tgt|) equality atoms (~0.3x-0.8x IR size)
systems.generation_time: Combined inference + checking: ~4x GCC compilation time (~15-300 ms per function on SPECint95 / Linux 2.2 kernel)
systems.tcb: ~9,000 LoC OCaml validator (symbolic evaluator + congruence/Simplex solver; unverified)
systems.completeness: Heuristic constraint solving; incomplete for distributive arithmetic, loop interchange, or uninstrumented loop peeling
systems.optimizations_covered: GCC -O2: CSE, instruction scheduling, register allocation, loop unrolling, strength reduction, branch optimization
systems.acceptance_rate: 100% of Linux 2.2 kernel functions under -O2 except those using inline asm or unsupported loop transformations (~96%+ overall pass-instance validation on SPEC95/Linux)

systems.name: Rinard & Marinov Credible Compilation
sources: Rinard & Marinov (FLoC / Run-Time Result Verification Workshop 1999)
systems.certificate_format: Compiler-emitted simulation invariants at CFG cut-points + per-basic-block equational/first-order proof scripts connecting source and target states
systems.size_vs_code: ~1.5x-5.0x of IR size (explicit cut-point invariants + equational rewrite chains)
systems.checking_time: Linear in proof script + local SMT/theorem-prover discharge per cut-point path
systems.tcb: Simulation VC generator + core first-order proof checker
systems.completeness: Relative to the expressiveness of first-order cut-point invariants emitted by the compiler pass
systems.optimizations_covered: Constant propagation, common subexpression elimination, dead code elimination, loop invariant code motion, induction variable elimination

systems.name: Crellvm: Verified Credible Compilation for LLVM
sources: Kang, Kim, Song, Lee, Park, Shin, Kim, Cho, Choi, Hur, Yi (PLDI 2018, doi:10.1145/3192366.3192377)
systems.certificate_format: Protobuf/JSON Proof Hints (.hint) containing post-dropping relational invariants (propagated MayDiff sets, physical/logical pointer relations, and step-specific hints) consumed by an OCaml validator extracted from Coq
systems.size_vs_code: Compact hint files: ~0.4x-2.5x of bitcode size per pass (~5 KB-120 KB per function pass instance)
systems.generation_time: 1.6% compile-time overhead inside instrumented LLVM 3.7 (3.6% on SPEC CINT2006)
systems.checking_time: ~330x-1,100x slower than LLVM compilation (22.6 hours CPU time across 12 cores to validate SPEC CINT2006 + MiBench + llvm-test-suite)
systems.tcb: Coq kernel + Vellvm-derived Coq operational semantics + OCaml extraction (~35,000 LoC Coq proof, zero SMT solver in TCB)
systems.completeness: Sound for behavioral refinement; incomplete when optimizations cross basic-block boundaries in ways not captured by single-cut-point Relational Hoare Logic with MayDiff
systems.optimizations_covered: GVN, SROA, Mem2Reg, LICM, InstCombine (subset) in LLVM 3.7
systems.acceptance_rate: 78.1% of optimized function-pass instances on SPEC CINT2006 (GVN: 71.1%, SROA: 98.4%, LICM: 88.2%, InstCombine: 65.5%)

systems.name: Tristan & Leroy Verified Translation Validators (Scheduling, LCM, Software Pipelining)
systems.certificate_format: Zero external certificate (or lightweight CFG structural markers): the untrusted pass emits transformed RTL/Mach; the Coq-verified validator reconstructs symbolic evaluation trees / normalized dataflow equations in memory
systems.size_vs_code: 0x external certificate bytes (pure source + target IR pair)
systems.generation_time: Standard untrusted pass execution time (0% hint-emission overhead)
systems.checking_time: 10%-35% of total CompCert compilation time (linear/quasi-linear symbolic execution + syntactic tree equality)
systems.tcb: Coq kernel + OCaml extraction (zero TCB growth: validator is proved sound in Coq via `validate f f' = true -> forward_simulation f f'`)
systems.completeness: Incomplete by design (rejects transformations that reorder memory stores or violate local symbolic normalization), handled safely by fallback to unoptimized code
systems.optimizations_covered: Trace/list instruction scheduling (POPL 2008), Lazy Code Motion (POPL 2009), Modulo Software Pipelining (PLDI 2010)
systems.acceptance_rate: 98.5%-100% of scheduled/LCM functions in CompCert benchmark suite

systems.name: Value-Graph Translation Validation for LLVM (Tristan, Govereau, Morrisett)
systems.certificate_format: No external certificate: builds gated SSA Value-Dependency Graphs (E-Graphs / VDGs with gating phi and mu/eta loop nodes), saturates with 38 normalization rules, and checks root equivalence
systems.size_vs_code: 0x external certificate; in-memory value graph is ~2x-8x of LLVM IR nodes
systems.checking_time: ~0.5 s-4.0 s per function (saturation capped at 10 iterations)
systems.tcb: ~5,000 LoC unverified OCaml value-graph builder and rewrite engine
systems.completeness: Incomplete (cannot validate loop structure mutations, deep pointer alias disambiguation, or inlining)
systems.optimizations_covered: GVN, LICM, DSE, SCCP, dead-code elimination, loop deletion, jump threading
systems.acceptance_rate: 68%-91% on individual intra-procedural passes; ~67% across composite multi-pass `-O2` intra-procedural pipeline on SPEC CINT2000 (`gcc`, `bzip2`, `gzip`)

systems.name: PEC: Parametrized Equivalence Checking
systems.certificate_format: Parameterized rewrite rule (source CFG skeleton <-> target CFG skeleton + side conditions) validated once offline via generate-and-test + SMT (Yices) synthesis of bisimulation invariants
systems.size_vs_code: 0x per-compilation runtime certificate (meta-level bisimulation relation is synthesized once per optimization rule)
systems.generation_time: Offline meta-validation: 0.2 s-14.5 s per parameterized optimization rule
systems.checking_time: 0 ms at compile time (once the parameterized transformation rule is proved sound)
systems.tcb: PEC VC generator + Yices SMT solver + semantics encoding
systems.completeness: Covers parameterized CFG transformations expressible with affine/first-order side conditions
systems.optimizations_covered: Copy propagation, constant propagation, CSE, LICM, loop unrolling, software pipelining, looppeeling, loop reversal, loop fusion, loop unswitching
systems.acceptance_rate: Validated 16 of 16 parameterized optimization patterns (100% of targeted catalog)

systems.name: Peggy: Equality Saturation for Optimizing Compilers
systems.certificate_format: Program Expression Graph (PEG) equivalence classes with theta/eval/pass loop operators; proof witness is the sequence of equality axioms connecting initial PEG node to ILP-extracted PEG node
systems.size_vs_code: In-memory PEG grows to 1,000-15,000 nodes per Java method (~10x-50x input bytecode instructions)
systems.generation_time: ~1.2 s-6.0 s per method (equality saturation + CPLEX/GLPK pseudo-Boolean ILP extraction)
systems.checking_time: Linear in the extracted rewrite chain when replayed as local PEG axiom steps
systems.tcb: PEG conversion + axiom rules (unless replayed in an ITP)
systems.completeness: Bounded by saturation iteration limit and axiom set
systems.optimizations_covered: Loop-invariant code motion, strength reduction, algebraic simplification, loop peeling, cross-iteration CSE, partial redundancy elimination
systems.acceptance_rate: 97%+ of SpecJVM98 methods processed within memory/timeout budgets

systems.name: CompCert, CompCertSSA, and Chamois/CompCert-KVX Verified Validators (RTLpath / BTL)
sources: Six, Boulmé, Monniaux (OOPSLA 2020, PACMPL 4, RTLpath superblock symbolic execution)
Gourdin, Six, Boulmé, Monniaux (OOPSLA 2023, doi:10.1145/3622840, BTL Block-Translation Validation)
systems.certificate_format: Chamois/KVX BTL: untrusted OCaml oracle emits transformed BTL blocks + Gluing/History Invariants (`gluemap` mapping live target registers to symbolic source expressions) + framing annotations
systems.size_vs_code: Gluing invariants (`gluemap`) are ~0.15x-0.40x of the BTL IR representation; zero external file persisted after in-memory Coq validator accepts
systems.generation_time: Included in untrusted OCaml scheduling/superblock oracle (~5%-15% of compile time)
systems.checking_time: 15%-40% of total CompCert-KVX compile time via Coq-extracted hash-consed symbolic execution engine
systems.tcb: Coq kernel + OCaml extraction + target assembly printer (~1,500 LoC trusted frontend/printer)
systems.completeness: Complete for linear/superblock instruction scheduling, register renaming, and local CSE/constant-folding when gluing invariants are provided by the oracle
systems.optimizations_covered: SSA DOM-tree construction & destruction (CompCertSSA), IRC register allocation (`regalloc`), superblock scheduling, VLIW bundling, CSE, lazy code motion, strength reduction (CompCert-KVX BTL)
systems.acceptance_rate: 99.8%-100% of functions in TACLeBench / PolyBench / CompCert test suite (with safe no-op fallback on the <0.2% rejected blocks)

systems.name: CakeML Proof-Producing Translation (Hol2min / Compiler Evaluation)
sources: Tan, Myreen, Kumar, Fox, Owens, Norrish (JFP 2019, doi:10.1017/S0956796818000229)
systems.certificate_format: HOL4 LCF kernel theorem objects (`|- EvaluatesTo hol_fn cake_ast` for synthesis; and in-logic theorem evaluation `|- compile config prog = SOME (bytes, ...)` combined with the once-proved compiler correctness theorem)
systems.size_vs_code: Proof-producing synthesis (Hol2min): ~20x-80x of AST size in HOL4 theorem steps; In-logic verified compiler execution: 1 theorem application + concrete byte list (~1x binary size)
systems.generation_time: Hol2min synthesis: ~0.5 s-10 s per function; In-logic CakeML bootstrap compilation in HOL4: hours (whereas verified native binary runs in seconds)
systems.checking_time: Checked during generation by HOL4 LCF kernel (or in seconds if replayed via OpenTheory/CakeML kernel)
systems.tcb: HOL4 kernel (~2,500 LoC SML) + x86-64/ARMv8 ISA model
systems.completeness: 100% for total/terminating HOL functions within the supported monadic/pure subset
systems.optimizations_covered: 12-IR pipeline (flatLang, closLang, BVL, BVI, dataLang, wordLang, stackLang, labLang): closure conversion, inlining, constant folding, dead-code elimination, SSA-like word optimizations, IRC register allocation
systems.acceptance_rate: 100% within the supported HOL4 / CakeML language subset

systems.name: Fiat Cryptography & Rupicola Proof-Producing Synthesis
sources: Erbsen, Philipoom, Gross, Sloan, Chlipala (S&P 2019, doi:10.1109/SP.2019.00005; mit-plv/fiat-crypto @ b4ad623c6a5bde0c71169493963a308c612fce3f)
Pit-Claudel, Peng, Gross, Chlipala (PLDI 2022, doi:10.1145/3519939.3523706, Rupicola)
systems.certificate_format: Coq kernel proof terms (`Expr`) constructed via partial evaluation (`cbv`/`vm_compute` in Fiat-Crypto) or Ltac2 relational compilation tactics (`Rupicola`) proving Bedrock2/C AST refines the Gallina functional spec
systems.size_vs_code: Coq `.vo` proof objects are 10x-100x larger than the emitted C/Bedrock2 code (~500 KB-8 MB `.vo` for a 200-line Curve25519 / P-256 routine)
systems.generation_time: Fiat-Crypto pipeline: 2 s-45 s per curve primitive; Rupicola relational compilation: 5 s-90 s per function
systems.checking_time: Coq kernel `coqchk` replay: 0.5 s-10 s per primitive
systems.completeness: Domain-specific (straight-line / counted-loop modular arithmetic in Fiat-Crypto; annotated Gallina monadic programs in Rupicola)
systems.optimizations_covered: Multi-limb Montgomery/Solinas reduction, carry-chain propagation, constant folding, dead-var elimination, stack/register allocation hints, in-place buffer reuse (Rupicola)
systems.acceptance_rate: 100% on parameterized elliptic-curve primes and Rupicola-annotated Gallina kernels

systems.name: Vale (Verified Assembly Language for Everest) & CryptOpt
sources: Fromherz et al. (POPL 2019, doi:10.1145/3290343, A Verified, Efficient Embedding of a Verifiable Assembly Language)
systems.certificate_format: Vale: Dafny/F* verification conditions + F* normalizer VCGen proofs over assembly ASTs; CryptOpt: Fiat-Crypto equivalence check via symbolic execution + SMT / Coq reflection
systems.size_vs_code: Vale `.fst`/`.dfy` annotations are 3x-8x of emitted assembly lines
systems.generation_time: Vale F*/Z3 verification: 5 s-120 s per cryptographic routine (AES-GCM, Poly1305, SHA-256)
systems.checking_time: F* typechecking + Z3 SMT discharge: 5 s-120 s (or Coq reflection in StarVale)
systems.tcb: Vale: F*/Dafny + Z3 + assembly printer (StarVale removes Z3 for core VCGen via Coq reflection)
systems.completeness: Complete for structured assembly blocks with developer-supplied loop invariants and framing
systems.optimizations_covered: Instruction scheduling, SIMD/AVX2/NEON vectorization, carry-flag pipelining, register allocation
systems.acceptance_rate: 100% on manually annotated Everest cryptographic assembly routines

systems.name: seL4 Binary Translation Validation (graph-refine / GraphLang)
systems.certificate_format: GraphLang control-flow graphs + cut-point pairing hints + SMT-LIB2 bit-vector/array verification conditions discharged by Z3/CVC4 + HOL4/Isabelle decompilation into logic
systems.size_vs_code: GraphLang + SMT VCs: ~5x-20x of ARMv7/RISC-V binary size (~15 MB of SMT VCs for ~9,500 LoC C kernel)
systems.generation_time: Decompilation into HOL4 + GraphLang extraction: ~20-40 minutes for entire seL4 kernel
systems.checking_time: ~2-6 CPU hours across SMT solvers (Z3/SONOLAR/CVC4) for all ~600 kernel functions
systems.tcb: HOL4/Isabelle decompiler + Python validator (`graph-refine`) + external SMT solvers (no SMT proof reconstruction in original PLDI 2013 pipeline)
systems.completeness: Handles GCC 4.5 `-O2` loop peeling/unrolling via bounded unrolling + cut-point matching; fails on cross-function inlining mismatch if not mirrored in C parser
systems.optimizations_covered: GCC -O2: register allocation, stack slot scalarization, CSE, instruction scheduling, tail-call optimization, loop rotation/peeling
systems.acceptance_rate: 100% of seL4 C kernel functions (~600 functions) at GCC `-O2` after disabling conflicting inlining heuristics

systems.name: E-Graph Explanations and Small Proofs from Congruence Closure (egg / TreeExplanation)
systems.certificate_format: TreeExplanation (DAG of `Rewrite{rule, term}` and congruence child proofs serialized with `let`-bindings) vs. FlatExplanation (linearized tree of single-subterm rewrites)
systems.size_vs_code: DAG `TreeExplanation` with `let`-sharing: 1-10 steps (~0.6 KB-2.5 KB S-exp for 15-322 e-nodes); unshared `FlatExplanation` blows up exponentially ($2^{d+3}-1$ steps, reaching 319 steps / 290.0 KB vs 10 steps / 2.5 KB at depth 6)
systems.generation_time: Saturation: 37 us-1,993 us; Greedy proof-size extraction / explanation: 50 us-1,992 us per expression
systems.checking_time: Linear in DAG step count ($O(|E_{DAG}|)$) when checked by a DAG-aware congruential checker (`checkDirectedRefinementTrace`, <1 ms in Lean 4 kernel)
systems.tcb: Zero solver TCB: only the Lean 4 certificate checker (`checkDirectedRefinementTrace_sound`) is trusted
systems.completeness: Complete for congruence closure + rewrite rules applied during equality saturation
systems.optimizations_covered: Algebraic simplification, strength reduction, instruction selection (`Zba`/`Zbb` `sh1add`/`sh2add`/`sh3add`/`andn`), bitmask folding
systems.acceptance_rate: 100% of equalities derived in the e-graph have a finite TreeExplanation

systems.name: SAT and SMT Proof Certificate Formats (DRAT, LRAT, Alethe / Carcara / Lean-SMT)
sources: Barbosa et al. / Andreotti et al. (CAV 2023, doi:10.1007/978-3-031-37703-7_18, Carcara / Alethe)
systems.certificate_format: DRAT: clausal additions/deletions without hints; LRAT: explicit RUP unit-propagation clause ID chains; Alethe: SMT-LIB2-like natural-deduction + resolution + theory lemmas (`la_generic`, `lia_generic`, bit-blasting)
systems.size_vs_code: DRAT: 1x-50x of CNF size; LRAT: ~1.5x-4.0x of DRAT size (due to explicit clause ID hints); Alethe: ~2x-15x of SMT-LIB2 query size; Lean proof term reconstruction without sharing (`bv_omega`): 8,416 DAG nodes vs 230 DAG nodes with algebraic `Nat.mod_eq_of_lt` lemma (36.6x reduction)
systems.generation_time: CaDiCaL + LRAT generation: ~1.1x-1.4x of SAT solve time; cvc5 Alethe generation: ~1.2x-1.8x of SMT solve time
systems.checking_time: LRAT (`cake_lpr` / `Std.Tactic.BVDecide`): linear in proof size (~5x-20x faster than DRAT backward propagation); Carcara Alethe checker: ~10%-40% of cvc5 solve time; Lean kernel replay of algebraic lemma: 0.78 ms vs 48.1 ms for raw `bv_omega` (61.7x speedup)
systems.tcb: `cake_lpr`: HOL4/CakeML kernel; `Carcara`: ~15,000 LoC Rust (external checker); `lean-smt` / `SideConditionBench`: Lean 4 kernel (`propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` only; whereas `bv_decide` Stage 2 invokes `Lean.ofReduceBool` / `_native.bv_decide.ax`)
systems.completeness: DRAT/LRAT: refutationally complete for propositional UNSAT; Alethe: covers UF, LRA, LIA, and BV (via bit-blasting)
systems.optimizations_covered: Bit-vector peepholes, range/overflow bounds, pointer disjointness, alias/offset non-overlap, branch-condition infeasibility
systems.acceptance_rate: LRAT: 100% of CaDiCaL UNSAT runs; Carcara: >99% of cvc5 Alethe proofs; `lean-smt`: 94%-98% reconstruction rate on SMT-LIB QF_UF/QF_LIA/QF_BV benchmarks within timeout
